meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Git 专家方式处理操作:先分析仓库状态和最近提交风格,再把变更拆成多个原子提交(文件越多提交越多),并处理 rebase/squash 与历史查询(blame、bisect、log -S)。
howto.when: 当你说出“commit”“rebase”“squash”等词,或询问“谁写的”“某行何时加的”“找出引入某变更的提交”等历史问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动分成几个原子提交,按仓库风格写信息。
say.note: Claude 会先分析再拆提交。

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个,并保留原风格。
say.note: 触发 REBASE 模式,执行压缩。

say.text: 用 git log -S 查一下这个字符串是哪个提交引入的。
say.note: 触发历史搜索找引入点。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a Git expert: inspects repo state and commit style, splits changes into multiple atomic commits (more files → more commits), handles rebase/squash, and searches history via blame, bisect, log -S.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or asks who wrote a line, when something was added, or to find the commit that introduced a change.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits and follow the repo style.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes then commits in chunks.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one, keeping the style.
Use git log -S to find which commit added this string.
say_en.note: Searches history for the introducing commit.
